title: Help with finding some good werewolves sprites that fits with rpg maker mz

posts.author: The_wolf_princess
posts.body:
Resource Type:
(Characters, Battlers.)
Maker Format:
(RPG MAKER  MZ)
Makers I Own:
(XP,Ace,MV, MZ)
Art Style:
(Cartoony, anime.)
Description:
I'm currently working on a werewolf horror thriller rpg in mz, and ive been trying to find some premade good werewolf sprites.
I cant draw at all! so i need some premade ones, i did find some normal wolf sprites on the internet  but thats not a werewolf sprite character,.
I need a white werewolf with blue eyes, and a black werewolf with red eyes
Movement sprite, battle sprite ,

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Hey, it would benefit your request if you could fill out the resource
request template
and add some extra information. Like there is a wolfman in the default MZ resources, what is the issue with it/him?
Also, what do you mean not a werewolf one? Must it be bipedal?

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Since you own MV, you can use hiddeone's anthro wolf generator parts to create what you need:
hiddenone's MV Resource Warehouse
hiddenone's MV Resource Warehouse  Newest Resources: Hine Galloping Horse  Hey folks, I love the look of the MV sprites, but it seems that things are a bit lacking.  I'm hoping to help fix that.   :)  TOS: Credit: hiddenone, Kadokawa, & Avery if you use the beastmen or accessory generator...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Or you can use GalacticGod's white version of the wolfman, he has a sv battler, too, though you'd need more recolors I guess
GalacticGod's MZ & MV Resources [Update 2-22-26]
Emos for some of the less 'heroic' characters - but wouldn't they make great party members if you wanted to have something a bit different! Well done on the choice.
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
GalacticGod's MZ & MV Resources [Update 2-22-26]
I'm not doing a modern project at the moment, but if I were these would be straight in there.  Such high quality work is amazing.
